dataset: Livingstone lab free viewing (Xiao, Sharma, Kreiman & Livingstone, Nature Neuroscience 2024; DANDI 000628)
summaryNote: 13 macaques, 679 sessions, Utah arrays in V1/V2, V4, PIT, CIT and AIT; 10,909 distinct picture contents (campaign census)

full.model: frames 1/3/10/30%: aug_crop_ttmR_cnn512_v2c evidence-ladder replays (random share of each picture's fixations, five folds, held out) rendered by B0; last frame: str48w_crop_ttmR_cnn512_v2c five-fold B0 render

faces.model: M2 face decoder (face_s48w_crop_tfpAkl003_E2joint, five folds) rendered by B0; novel faces only, ordered by fixations within 2 deg of the face box
